races.name: Clive Cox Racing EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Foscarini
runners_data.spotlight: 9,000euros foal, 45,000gns yearling; first foal; dam placed 7f AW (RPR 71), half-sister to winners Double March (7f 2yo/1m2f) and Emperor's Son (5f including 2yo), out of unraced half-sister to 1m Listed winner; this Without Parole newcomer could go well for his in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Minzazi
runners_data.spotlight: 42,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling; sixth foal; Minzaal half-brother to winners Another Investment (6f/7f including 2yo; RPR 95), Shrara (6f 2yo; 71) and Ibn Alwaleed (KSA 1m 2yo); dam US 5f 2yo/6f dirt winner; stable has made a strong start to June and the betting could be informative on debut.

runners_data.name: Secret Society
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000euros foal, £48,000 yearling; eighth foal; Cotai Glory brother to two winners including Time Douglas (Italian 5f/6f), half-brother to 7f/1m winner Linwood (including 2yo; RPR 116); trainer sponsors the race and has enjoyed plenty of success in it in recent years; has to be respected on debut.

runners_data.name: Undiscovered
runners_data.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; second foal; dam runner-up in France, half-sister to winners Al Wukair (1m Group 1) and Dream Today (useful 6f/7f), out of 1m 2yo winner; top trainer has solid 23% strike-rate with 2yos here in the last five seasons; this New Bay debutant is one to be interested in.

runners_data.name: Lord Of Winterfell
runners_data.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling, 32,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/US; RPR 96), half-sister to 1m4f/1m6f winner Codiak, out of French Listed-placed 1m4f winner; a watching brief may prove wisest with this New Bay newcomer.

runners_data.name: Glory Bound
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000euros yearling, resold 17,000gns yearling; first foal; dam 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 84), half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 2 winner Leovanni; this Cotai Glory newcomer may improve for the run.

runners_data.name: Ten Year Stretch
runners_data.spotlight: 11,000euros yearling; fourth foal; Inns Of Court half-brother to Italian 7.5f 2yo-1m2f winner Nuncepossocrede; dam unplaced 1m-11.4f (RPR 67), half-sister to three winners; trainer hasn't run many 2yos this year but there have been promising signs; could run well on debut.

runners_data.name: Half A Hoof
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to four winners and a market check is advised on this second start, but she was well beaten at 18-1 in a fillies' novice at Ascot (5f, good) on last month's debut.

runners_data.name: Benefacta
runners_data.spotlight: Inexperience evident during the first half of last month's debut outing at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) but the penny dropped somewhat and he finished seventh of 12, beaten just over 3l at 11-1; this half-brother to three winners may have learnt a lot from that initial experience.

runners_data.name: Green Titan
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten on debut at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) 19 days ago and needs to leave that form miles behind, but he was sent off at just 100-30 and it will be worth noting whether or not his backers return.

runners_data.name: Empire Rising
runners_data.spotlight: Drifted to 7-1 from 4-1 on last month's debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm), where he blew the start and was always behind; hard to fancy on the back of that but this 70,000euros yearling is likely to be a much better proposition at some point.

runners_data.name: Prince Kameo
runners_data.spotlight: He's shown ability on both starts (6f, AW/good) but not enough to suggest he'll be coming out on top today; nurseries beckon.

races.name: Clive Cox Racing EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Goodwood Meteor
runners_data.spotlight: 48,000gns yearling; by Minzaal; third foal; dam unraced sister to winners Taajub (useful 5f/6f) and Excel Yourself (5f/6f 2yo), out of unraced half-sister to two Group winners; likely to improve for this debut run.

runners_data.name: Green Dividend
runners_data.spotlight: 30,000gns foal, 40,000gns yearling; first foal; dam placed 1m2f (RPR 71), half-sister to winners Advertise (6f/6.5f Group 1 including 2yo) and Flavius Titus (useful 6f/7f including 2yo); trainer among the winners with 2yos; the betting could be informative regarding this Showcasing newcomer.

runners_data.name: No More Pino
runners_data.spotlight: 47,000gns yearling, 40,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; second foal; dam 7f winner (including 2yo; RPR 95), half-sister to several winner, out of 5f 2yo winner; wears a hood and this Blue Point newcomer may be best watched.

runners_data.name: Walbrook
runners_data.spotlight: 58,000euros yearling; seventh foal; Cotai Glory brother to 6f-1m winner Alpha Capture (including 2yo Listed), half-brother to three winners including Acklam Express (5f including 2yo Listed; 113); trainer is enjoying a good season but he's not known for 2yo winners; check the betting on debut.

runners_data.name: Beresford Gap
runners_data.spotlight: 27,000euros yearling; second foal; Acclamation half-brother to 7f AW winner Giles Glory (RPR 58); dam 7f AW 2yo winner (72), half-sister to 7f/1m winner, out of 1m winning half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Amazing Maria; yard 8-48 (17%) with 2yos here in last five years; could go well on debut.

runners_data.name: Flying Pirate
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000euros yearling; first foal; dam US Graded stakes-placed 1m turf 2yo winner (RPR 98); in-form trainer can ready a 2yo first time up; this Blackbeard newcomer could be in the mix.

runners_data.name: Make No Mistake
runners_data.spotlight: £20,000 yearling; eighth foal; closely related to US/Canadian 6.5f/7f winner Oops, half-brother to 5f/5.7f winner Suanni (including 2yo; RPR 83); dam placed in Germany, sister to Group-placed 5f 2yo winner Tawaabb; trainer has fine recent record in this race, which features his name in the title, so this Magna Grecia newcomer is well worth a second look.

runners_data.name: Invicta Rose
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000euros yearling, £25,000 2yo breeze-ups; by State Of Rest; eighth foal; closely related to 7f/1m winner Tam Lin (RPR 73), half-sister to French 12.5f winner; dam 6f AW 2yo winner (69), half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Chelsea Rose; takes on males on debut and may be one for later on.

runners_data.name: Aphra Behn
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; Territories half-sister to French winners Sandon (1m2f 2yo) and Betty Nelson (10.5f); dam French 1m2f winner, half-sister to French 1m2f/10.5f winner, out of maiden sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Ana Marie; races against males on debut but trainer does very well here with his 2yos.

runners_data.name: Rattenbury
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and always behind when 28-1 for last Monday's debut at Lingfield (6f, good); he may have learnt from that experience but a hefty step forward is needed this afternoon.

runners_data.name: Harry Knows
runners_data.spotlight: Went very close on debut at Newbury (5f, good) in April; underwhelming when odds-on and fourth of six at Goodwood (5f, good) since but he was short of room late on and has been gelded since; the step up to 6f can help and he's a strong contender if tapping back into his debut promise.

runners_data.name: Blue Skies Above
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten on his first two starts (6f, AW/good) and considerable improvement is needed if he's to pose a threat.

races.name: Remembering Jane Samuels Handicap

runners_data.name: Lazzar
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader but turf form below AW standard and saddle issues last time raise reliability concerns
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins have been over 6f on the AW, the most recent at Kempton in March; below his best on turf in recent starts but did have an excuse (saddle slipped) at Bath four days ago; best watched.

runners_data.name: Arantes Nascimento
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up type but unraced on soft ground creates significant doubt about effectiveness
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced on soft; 2-14 on the AW (wins over 7f) compared to 0-11 on turf but it was a good effort when second of ten at Newmarket (6f, good) 24 days ago; contender if handling conditions.

runners_data.name: Newsreader
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with soft ground form but 49 days off and trainer struggling for winners
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins came on the AW when trained by Kevin Philippart De Foy but he's twice been placed on turf since joining this stable, including on soft; well held at Pontefract (6f, good) in April but may have needed that first start for 194 days.

runners_data.name: Thunderous Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven course and distance form who benefits from today's lower mark
runners_data.spotlight: Six wins include two over C&D and she was runner-up here on heavy ground in September off a 5lb higher mark than today's; below her best in recent starts but probably wasn't helped by racing on the wing at Goodwood four days ago; chance.

runners_data.name: Lodge
runners_data.note: Promising prominent type but only one soft ground experience and 57 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Ffos Las (6f, good) on his debut last August before a solid effort under a penalty at Windsor (6f, soft); respectable handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in January but well beaten in two starts since; tongue-tie applied.

runners_data.name: Distant Rumble
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving rapidly but unproven on soft ground despite strong recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced on soft; runner-up over this C&D last month before going on better at Windsor on good to firm 17 days ago; still fairly treated following a 3lb rise but testing ground would be a concern.

runners_data.name: Supreme King
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer but better on AW than turf with limited soft ground experience
runners_data.spotlight: Five of his six wins have been on the AW, the most recent at Kempton in February when completing a hat-trick; sole win on turf came at Doncaster (good to soft) and he posted a respectable effort there 24 days ago; drops in grade with claims.

runners_data.name: Unico
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner suited by soft conditions and benefits significantly from low weight allocation
runners_data.spotlight: 3-27, the most recent of those wins coming at Brighton (5.5f, soft) in September; caught wide at Kempton on her first start for 137 days but now has the cheekpieces back on and may take a step forward.

runners_data.name: Addictive
runners_data.note: Prominent type but six-race maiden resuming after 21 days off following poor Windsor effort
runners_data.spotlight: Six-race maiden who was last of 11 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) on his stable debut following 627 days ago; never featured over 5f at Lingfield three weeks ago but this step back up in trip may help.

runners_data.name: Invincible Speed
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose four wins all came on AW with soft ground presenting major unknown
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins have been on the AW but he does act on turf; beaten 4l when second of five at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) ten days ago but soft ground would be a slight concern.

runners_data.name: Phoenix Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up type showing turf improvement but all wins on AW at Lingfield only
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins have been on the AW at Lingfield (6f) but she's posted good efforts on turf on her last two starts, latest when the blindfold came off late at Bath (5.5f, firm) two weeks ago; slower ground probably wouldn't be ideal.

races.paceDynamic: Lazzar will lead unopposed from the gates with Lodge, Thunderous Love and Addictive settling prominently behind him, creating a measured pace that won't stretch the field early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this becomes a tactical affair with plenty left for the finish. Hold-up horses like Arantes Nascimento, Newsreader, Supreme King and Unico will track the leaders patiently before launching their bids. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to the pace without early pressure, then kick clear when the hold-up horses are still finding their stride.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Kick Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses capitalise on their ideal positioning when the pace lifts at the two-furlong marker
scenarios.body: Lodge and Thunderous Love travel sweetly behind the uncontested leader and have first run on the field when they quicken. The hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the change of pace and struggle to close the gap despite their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and sustained pace allows the closers enough time to mount their challenges
scenarios.body: Arantes Nascimento and Supreme King use their proven class to reel in the leaders despite giving them a head start. Their superior turn of foot tells in the final furlong as the prominent runners begin to tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the well-handicapped horses with claims exploit the race dynamics perfectly
scenarios.body: Unico benefits from her low weight and soft ground form while Phoenix Moon's recent turf improvement continues under Marquand's tactical ride. The favourites either go too early or leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Lazzar sets an unsustainably slow pace that becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble in the final two furlongs where any horse with a clear run can prevail. Jockey strength and racing room become more important than running style or ratings.

watchPoints.text: Lazzar could set funeral pace given no pressure then quicken suddenly catching hold-up horses cold
Arantes Nascimento and Invincible Speed both unproven on soft despite strong recent form suggesting they handle it
Lodge making seasonal reappearance after 57 days could need the run despite promising profile
Thunderous Love dropping 5lb from September course run on heavy could be well-handicapped for conditions
Watch for Phoenix Moon settling better on turf with blindfold coming off late at Bath last time

races.name: Danny McNab Bookmakers Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bright Summer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with winning form carrying penalty, suited by the likely honest pace
runners_data.spotlight: Built upon the promise of her debut fourth at Newbury (7f, good) in April when winning at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month; carries a penalty against some interesting rivals but did it nicely last time and she's respected.

runners_data.name: Rajiba
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer dropping back in trip after good recent second, needs pace collapse
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten far when fourth on debut at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last November and reappeared with good second there (8.6f, AW) last Monday; drops back in trip today but it was a slowly run race last time; a possible.

runners_data.name: Areti
runners_data.note: Front-runner with soft ground question marks despite consistent place record
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 and there's a question mark regarding slow ground, but she's been runner-up on her last two starts (7f/1m, AW) and her form reads well, albeit with others probably possessing greater scope to improve; a tongue-tie goes on; could again be thereabouts if returning from a break at the top of her game.

runners_data.name: Bold Shout
runners_data.note: Promising prominent type stepping up from debut fourth, pedigree suggests improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 10-1, showed promise when fourth of ten on last Monday's debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm), beaten just under 3l; there's potential in his pedigree and he could take a step forward today.

runners_data.name: Lucky Luna
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who may have been unsuited by Chester's sharp track last time
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well for fourth over 6f here (good) on last month's debut; backwards step when sixth at Chester (7f, good) since but the sharp track may not have suited; each-way player if tapping back into her debut promise.

runners_data.name: Sapphire Secret
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner seeking improvement after disappointing spring efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Unable to pose a threat this spring on her first two starts (7f/8.6f, good/AW); however, she's shown signs of promise and there can be optimism that this well-bred filly will prove to be progressive; chance.

runners_data.name: Le Samourai
runners_data.note: Expensive debutant with elite breeding but unknown going preference
runners_data.spotlight: 450,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to five winners including Romantic Warrior (6f-1m2f including multiple Group/Grade 1s) and End Of Romance (6f-1m; RPR 99); the sole newcomer but he's in excellent hands and could play a leading role, especially if strong in the betting.

runners_data.name: Hugh
runners_data.note: Front-runner with strong finishing kick, 41 days since last run could be ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging fourth on debut at Kempton (6f, AW) in April and close second at Southwell (6f, AW) later that month, having led; he wasn't stopping at the line last time and 7f may well be within range; might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Back At One
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from strong stable but showed little on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Short of room soon after the start and always towards rear when 10-1 for recent debut at Kempton (7f, AW); however, his trainer has won two of the last five runnings and this 160,000euros yearling is open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Jean's Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner comprehensively beaten at huge odds in two starts
runners_data.spotlight: It's early days for this half-brother to three winners but he's been beaten a long way at 40-1 and 100-1 on his first two starts.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Jive
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with useful breeding but showed nothing on debut, 71-day break
runners_data.spotlight: He has a useful pedigree and may have needed his debut experience at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in March, when 11-1, but he was beaten a long way and a transformation is necessary this afternoon.

runners_data.name: Siddal
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with poor record including on similar soft ground
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field at Newbury (6.5f, soft) last October on sole 2yo start and same story when 80-1 at Kempton (7f, AW) a fortnight ago; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Paint Your Palette
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from Dubai disasters, dramatic improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off for this yard in two conditions races on dirt at Meydan (7f/1m) in the winter; went through the sales ring for 2,000gns in April; dramatic improvement is needed on her first turf start.

runners_data.name: Dupont Circle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but well beaten at massive odds in both career starts
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten at triple-figure odds on both starts (1m, AW).

races.paceDynamic: Areti and Hugh will contest the early lead, with both having shown front-running tendencies in recent starts. Their battle should create an honest gallop over the 7f trip on soft ground, preventing any crawling pace that could favour deep closers. Bright Summer and Bold Shout will likely track the leaders prominently, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground on testing conditions. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace and strike when the front-runners weaken, as the soft ground will make closing sectionals demanding.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Strike Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Bright Summer or Bold Shout position perfectly behind the leading pair
scenarios.body: The leaders' battle sets up ideal striking distance for the prominent runners who avoid the worst of the soft ground's impact. Bright Summer's penalty-carrying form and Bold Shout's debut promise make them perfectly positioned.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If one of Areti or Hugh gets first run on their rival
scenarios.body: The winner breaks clear before the soft ground fully takes its toll, holding off late challenges. Hugh's finishing kick at Southwell suggests he can sustain his effort better than most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Storms
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and collapses dramatically
scenarios.body: The soft ground and competitive early gallop sets up a late charge from the back markers with the stamina to finish. Rajiba's hold-up style and recent form progression makes her the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Le Samourai shows immediate class on debut despite the conditions
scenarios.body: The expensive yearling's breeding overcomes inexperience and going concerns to deliver a shock result. His half-brother Romantic Warrior's quality suggests latent ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Areti and Hugh go too fast early - their battle could set up the race for prominent runners like Bright Summer
Monitor Le Samourai's market moves closely as expensive breeding suggests connections expect a bold show despite going concerns
Watch for any late money on Sapphire Secret as Charlton stable could have found improvement after disappointing spring efforts
Check if Hugh shows the same finishing kick that nearly won at Southwell - soft ground may not suit his acceleration
Observe how Rajiba handles the drop back to 7f after staying on well over longer recently

races.name: Kingsclere Racing Club Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Centrum
runners_data.note: High-class debutant with Enable connections, but unproven Havlin booking suggests confidence may be limited
runners_data.spotlight: Colt by Dubawi; thirteenth foal; half-brother to eight winners including Enable (1m-1m4f including 2yo/AW/Oaks/dual Arc; RPR 129), Derab (Listed-placed 1m; 115) and Contribution (1m4f/1m7f; 106); dam 1m2f winner (including Listed; 102), sister to 12.5f Group 2 winner Dance Routine; bred to be smart and he's of interest on debut.

runners_data.name: Herstmonceux
runners_data.note: Trainer struggling badly this fortnight, claimer up suggests low expectations despite breeding
runners_data.spotlight: Gelding by Ulysses; tenth foal; half-brother to winners Timothy T (7.6f 2yo; RPR 92), Poetic Light (7.7f 2yo; 83), Suitsus (6f AW/1m turf; 74) and Equal Point (6f AW; 66); dam unplaced 6.5f/7f 2yo (35), out of sister to 1m2f/2m Listed winner Upper Strata; wears blinkers for his debut.

runners_data.name: Traveling Man
runners_data.note: Expensive yearling making debut for in-form Fellowes yard, but stable jockey not riding
runners_data.spotlight: Gelding by Too Darn Hot; 360,000gns yearling; third foal; closely related to winners Al Musmak (7f-1m1f including 2yo/dirt/Listed; RPR 113) and Mahshoom (KSA 1m1f); dam unraced half-sister to useful 1m1f-1m4f winner Boltaway, out of quadruple US 1m/1m1f Grade 1 winner; nice pedigree and the market should be informative on his debut.

runners_data.name: Besieged
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with two solid seconds, 25 days since last run ideal for improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Showed plenty when a 1l second at Kempton (1m, AW) on his debut in April and built on that when second of 11 at Newbury (1m2f, good) 25 days ago; dam finished runner-up in a Group 1 on testing ground; sets the standard.

runners_data.name: Long Reign
runners_data.note: Lightly raced but showed little in two runs, 29 days off may not be enough to find improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little on his debut at Newbury (1m, good; 125-1; subsequently gelded) and again finished well beaten at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) 29 days ago; not easy to recommend.

runners_data.name: Last Trump
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping back in trip after disappointing at this course 37 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with promise at Newbury (1m3f, good) in April but wasn't able to build on that when fourth of eight here over 1m4f (good to firm) 37 days ago; drops to 1m2f and looks the type to do better when handicapping.

runners_data.name: Poor Relation
runners_data.note: Promising AW form but 140 days off the track, strong jockey booking catches the eye
runners_data.spotlight: Caught the eye when fifth of 11 on her debut at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December and built on that when runner-up at Southwell (1m, AW) 140 days ago, despite hanging left; steps up in trip on her first start since and she's open to further progress.

runners_data.name: Much
runners_data.note: Well beaten on both starts including here 25 days ago, tongue tie applied suggests trainer concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in eighth in a race won by Derby runner-up Maltese Cross at Newbury (1m2f, good) on his debut and never featured over that same C&D 25 days ago; pedigree suggests slightly further may suit, and handicaps may be more his thing.

runners_data.name: Notable Charm
runners_data.note: Struggles to stay race distance based on poor finishing efforts in both runs
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled on his debut at Newbury (1m, good; 150-1) in April and it was the same story at Lingfield (1m, AW) 28 days ago; pedigree suggests this step up in trip will suit but handicaps may be more suitable.

runners_data.name: Easwrith Destiny
runners_data.note: Raced too freely last time at Chepstow, needs to settle better to be competitive
runners_data.spotlight: 200-1 when beaten 22l on his debut at Newbury (1m2f, good) in April and again finished well beaten after racing freely at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) 19 days ago; probably one for handicaps later on.

runners_data.name: Cartrefle
runners_data.note: Tailed off in both career starts and 201 days since last seen, hard to recommend
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off when last of seven on his debut at Redcar (1m1f, good to soft) in October and he again failed to beat a rival home at Southwell (1m, AW) next time; others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Besieged will be the sole early leader from his prominent style, setting an uncontested pace with Notable Charm and Easwrith Destiny likely to race handily behind. The lack of genuine speed horses means a sedate gallop is probable over this 1m2f trip on soft ground. With no pressure on the leader and limited pace throughout, this sets up perfectly for horses that can sit close and kick late. This tactical scenario heavily favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Besieged gets an easy lead and isn't passed in the straight.
scenarios.body: The experienced gelding controls the tempo and has enough in reserve to repel late challengers on ground that suits. His two solid seconds show he's ready to break his maiden when getting these tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Gosden/Fellowes debutants shows significant ability.
scenarios.body: Centrum or Traveling Man use superior breeding and training to overcome inexperience, with their connections' strike rates demanding respect. The soft ground won't inconvenience these well-bred types.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even slower than expected allowing closers to strike.
scenarios.body: Last Trump or Much get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kick from off the pace. The extended trip and testing ground play into the hands of horses with stamina to burn.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Besieged stops quickly and prominent runners also fade.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a messy finish where any horse finding late momentum can win. Poor Relation's AW form or a Tregoning runner like Long Reign could benefit from the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Besieged getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through half-mile he becomes very dangerous
Centrum and Traveling Man in the paddock - their debuts could reveal significant ability from top connections
Poor Relation's fitness after 140 days off - Murphy booking suggests ability but ring rustiness a concern
Notable Charm's early position - if he can settle better than previous runs the trip extension may help
Last Trump's tactics - needs to be held up longer than his previous front-running attempt here

races.name: Everywhen Margadale Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Affection
runners_data.note: Unknown running style and 54-day break create uncertainty, but French form on testing ground could translate well
runners_data.spotlight: Previously trained in France and she's won four of her ten starts, the most recent win coming by a neck in a claimer at Salon-de-Provence (1m4f, good to soft) 54 days ago; drops back in trip for her stable/British debut and the betting should be informative.

runners_data.name: Regal Charm
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 228-day layoff faces tactical test if pressured early by other forward types
runners_data.spotlight: Won a novice at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last August on her second start and ran well in a handicap at Newbury (1m2f, soft) 228 days ago; off since but she should have a bit more to offer after just five starts.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Baby
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but faces step up from all-weather to soft turf for first time this year
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from eight starts came in a maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in January and she's posted some solid efforts there in handicaps since; however, she now steps up in trip following a poor effort there 40 days ago and needs to bounce back on her turf debut.

runners_data.name: Typical Woman
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to likely pace scenario, though unproven on soft ground specifically
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced on soft but handles good to soft; below her best in three starts this year but now drops back in grade off the same mark as when winning at Lingfield (1m1f, good to firm) last year; returning cheekpieces are another plus.

runners_data.name: Rossa Raheen
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid soft ground form figures, well-positioned tactically if pace develops correctly
runners_data.spotlight: Ran to a similar level in two starts last year for David Menuisier (1m, soft/good to soft) and posted an improved effort despite not getting the best of runs in a handicap at Newbury (1m2f, good) 25 days ago on her second start for this stable; unexposed and looks a big player.

runners_data.name: Albus Anne
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent soft/heavy ground record, though 188-day absence raises fitness questions
runners_data.spotlight: All five of her wins have been at Bath (1m/1m2f) with four of them on soft/heavy, the latest over 1m2f in October off a 4lb lower mark than today's; third in both starts over this C&D and she's proven fresh, so is of some interest on her first start for 188 days.

runners_data.name: Royal Poetry
runners_data.note: Prominent style could benefit from tactical positioning, but needs to prove stamina at this extended trip
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt when making all in a novice at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) in April before finishing a good second of four over this C&D (good to firm) on her handicap debut; however, she was disappointing at Newmarket 24 days ago and needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Morven
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with proven soft ground form, well-suited to expected pace scenario and tactical development
runners_data.spotlight: Won a novice at Hamilton (1m, good to soft) in September on her second start but was well beaten in a Listed event at Pontefract (1m, soft) next time; good effort when beaten a head at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) on her reappearance and has solid claims if seeing out this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Regal Charm will likely dictate terms from the front with minimal pressure, as the other prominent runners Jazzy Baby and Royal Poetry may sit closer but won't apply serious heat early. The moderate early gallop will allow the hold-up horses Typical Woman, Rossa Raheen, Albus Anne and Morven to get into good positions turning for home. With soft ground testing stamina reserves and a manageable pace likely to produce a sprint finish, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with a turn of foot over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and runners bunch up turning in
scenarios.body: The soft ground and restrained early pace will create perfect conditions for closers to unleash their finishing kicks. Hold-up specialists with proven soft ground form will have ideal positioning and momentum when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Regal Charm wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Regal Charm gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Her class edge and tactical advantage from the front could prove decisive if she gets her own way early. The long absence becomes less relevant if she faces no sustained pressure until late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent racer surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race and front-runners falter
scenarios.body: Horses tracking the leaders in striking positions will benefit from a true-run race that exposes pure front-runners. Royal Poetry and Jazzy Baby have the tactical speed to capitalize on a moderate pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: French raider upset
scenarios.trigger: If Affection shows improved form on soft ground
scenarios.body: Her lightly-raced profile and French breeding could translate to untapped potential on testing ground. The long break and unknown style create upset possibilities if she's significantly better than her rating suggests.

watchPoints.text: Regal Charm's fitness after 228 days off could see her fade if the pace quickens late
Affection's unknown running style might disrupt expected pace dynamics if she shows early speed
Jazzy Baby stepping up from all-weather to soft turf represents significant surface change
Royal Poetry's stamina at 1m2f needs proving after recent shorter-distance efforts
Albus Anne's fitness levels after 188-day break despite strong soft ground record

races.name: Charter 1227 Catering Handicap

runners_data.name: Tenzi
runners_data.note: Only front runner with clear tactical advantage, uncontested lead likely, 11 days since last run ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise on turf last summer (good/soft ) and won a novice at Southwell (7f, AW) this March; however, she hasn't posed a serious threat in two handicaps subsequently (6f, AW/good to firm) and needs something extra today.

runners_data.name: Grand Vista
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with strong finishing pedigree, 29 days off may need this run, Tom Marquand booking significant
runners_data.spotlight: He's shown hints of promise among his three starts (including on soft ground) and his pedigree provides optimism that he can prove better than his opening mark; wears first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: Yes Waliim
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner struggling in handicaps, 7lb claimer reduces weight burden, needs to prove stamina at 6f
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 and unable to make an impact this year in his first two handicaps; however, he made late headway when 4l sixth of eight at Lingfield last time (5f, good; unraced on softer) and might have a part to play back up to 6f.

runners_data.name: Marra Donna
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who hung badly left on turf last time, first-time tongue tie applied, needs to handle soft ground
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 0-9 and he wasn't at his best (hung badly left) on a rare turf start at Windsor (6f, good; fifth) three weeks ago; needs to prove he can get the job done but he's on a handy mark on his consistent AW form earlier this year; not written off.

runners_data.name: Madman
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better on all-weather than turf, soft ground unproven, David Probert booking positive
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Kempton (6f, AW) in January and he's on a good mark on his peak AW form; however, he hasn't been at his best back on turf on his first two outings for this stable, and is 0-9 on grass.

runners_data.name: Wayward Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up type off basement mark, first-time blinkers applied, Beckett runner dropping in class
runners_data.spotlight: She's achieved little this spring on her first three starts (6f, good to firm/AW/good); however, she's with a top trainer and goes handicapping off a basement mark in first-time headgear; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: That's Random
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner on opening handicap mark, 36 days since last run may need this outing
runners_data.spotlight: He's not obviously well treated off this opening mark but has shown some ability among his first three starts (7f/6f, AW) and is bred to be better than this grade; no surprise if he takes a sizeable step forward.

runners_data.name: Barry The Worm
runners_data.note: Hold-up type wearing cheekpieces since last win, 40 days off makes him rusty, soft ground concern
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt when wearing first-time cheekpieces (retained since) in a nursery at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last November; April's reappearance sixth at Southwell (6f, AW) gives him something to build on and he's a possible contender if the return to turf isn't an issue.

runners_data.name: Maid In Devon
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner last month, 5lb penalty for recent victory, Oisin Murphy booking stands out
runners_data.spotlight: Built upon first two handicap performances to win in a big field over C&D last month (good; Stock Market second); 5lb higher today and slower ground is forecast, but she may have more to offer now things have clicked.

runners_data.name: Stock Market
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish, failed to settle last time, needs to prove stamina over 6f
runners_data.spotlight: 12-race maiden who failed to settle when below par at Chepstow (5f, good to soft) latest; however, seven days earlier he was a close second to Maid In Devon over C&D (good) and can be thereabouts if bouncing back.

runners_data.name: Follow My Heart
runners_data.note: Hold-up type well beaten by stablemate last time, useful 7lb weight allowance with Gina Mangan
runners_data.spotlight: No match for stablemate Maid In Devon and Stock Market when fourth of 15 on last month's handicap debut over C&D (good), which came after a break; she has a useful pedigree and is open to improvement, especially if her efforts are channeled in a straight line (hung right last time).

runners_data.name: Grimese's Special
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner disappointing since heavy ground win, returns to slower surface, needs to recapture form
runners_data.spotlight: She's been very disappointing on her three starts (1m/7f, AW/good) since winning a seller here (7f, heavy) last September on her second start; the return to slow ground needs to prompt a dramatic revival.

races.paceDynamic: Tenzi is the only confirmed front runner in this 12-runner field, giving her a clear tactical advantage to set her own tempo without early pressure. The remaining 11 runners are all hold-up types, meaning they'll be bunched together tracking Tenzi's uncontested lead through the early stages. On soft ground over 6f at Salisbury, this creates a classic scenario where the lone pace-setter can dictate proceedings and potentially kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front runners who can exploit the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tenzi Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Tenzi gets an uncontested lead and maintains her stamina
scenarios.body: She can dictate the pace without pressure and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still getting organized behind her. The soft ground and 6f distance suit her previous winning form at 7f.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Catches Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly and Tenzi weakens late
scenarios.body: The quality hold-up performers like Maid In Devon and Grand Vista can use their superior ratings to overhaul a tiring leader in the final furlong. Superior class tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tenzi Kicks Too Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Tenzi goes too fast early and burns out in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Her uncontested lead becomes a liability as she hits the wall, allowing the strongest finishers to sweep past her in the final 100 yards. The soft ground saps her stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Tenzi goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means the race becomes a dash from the 2f pole, suiting horses with the highest top speed ratings. Late tactical speed becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Tenzi could get too easy a lead with no other pace in the race and steal a long way from home
Stock Market has a tendency to fade in the finish and may not handle the soft ground switch
Marra Donna hung badly left on her last turf start and may repeat this on the Salisbury bends
Grand Vista has been off 29 days and this may be a prep run for bigger targets later
Maid In Devon carries a 5lb penalty for her recent course and distance victory which makes her task harder
